home.hero_label: Est. in the Heart of Odessa
home.hero_description: Where Italian precision meets the architectural soul of Ukraine. We make more than furniture: pieces that stay in your home for generations.
home.philosophy_quote: We do not believe in the temporary. Every piece that leaves our workshop is built to witness a century of family gatherings.
home.philosophy_body: Rooted in the rich artisan traditions of Odessa and inspired by Italian furniture design, our furniture workshop and its team of craftsmen specialise in joinery that defies mass-market standards. We use natural and traditional materials that bring tactile pleasure to everyday use, oils to preserve the living soul of the material, and modern techniques that ensure comfort and durability.
home.plan_body: Kitchen, bedroom, doors, stairs: we take on the whole home so every detail shares one character. Move across the plan to see what we make for each room.
home.plan_hint: Tap a room on the plan

process.label: How it happens
process.title: Four steps. One team.
process.body: Our team leads every project, from the first visit to installation. The furniture is made by the professional craftsmen of our workshop and fitted by our own installers. No middlemen: the people you talk to are the ones accountable for the result.
process.talk_body: Tell us what the room needs. We visit the space, take measurements and study what is already there: the floors, the walls, the finishes a new piece has to match. By phone, in Telegram or on site in Odessa.
process.draw_title: Every piece drawn to the millimetre
process.draw_body: We draw the piece with its materials, hardware and finishes before any wood is cut. You approve the drawing. If an architect or designer is on your project, we work from their plans alongside them.
process.make_title: Made by our team in our Odessa workshop
process.make_body: Oak, walnut, ash, metal, glass. The piece is built by the workshop’s craftsmen and finished with natural oils that keep the wood alive to the touch.
process.fit_title: Fitted to your home, not the other way round
process.fit_body: We bring the piece to you and fit it on site, adjusting to walls that are rarely straight and floors that are rarely level. Then it stays with you, built to be passed down.

about.title: The Ivolga Workshop
about.subtitle: Custom furniture in Odessa since 2003
about.lede: Ivolga began with a single kitchen and became a workshop in Odessa in 2003. Over time, a team of professionals grew around it. The work has stayed the same: furniture that looks just as good twenty years on.
about.body:
Ivolga grew out of the 1990s. Ukraine's economy was still finding its feet, and the people who would later found the workshop worked for several companies, gaining the kind of experience that was hard to come by anywhere else. Those years had another side, too: Odessa is a port city, and cheap, poorly made goods poured in through it. That is where the idea for the business came from: make things well, not just make them.

The first job was a kitchen, designed and built by hand from start to finish. It worked, and the work kept coming. In 2003, the idea became a company: a workshop in Odessa with a simple rule. Take work worth doing, and do it with care.

Twenty-plus years on, Ivolga is a team: the people who run each project from the first conversation to installation, the craftsmen who build the furniture, and our own installers. The approach hasn't changed. Homeowners, restaurant owners and developers across Ukraine and further out come to us when they want something made, not selected.

about.craft_text:
We don't avoid complicated projects. Full apartment interiors, restaurants, spaces with unusual layouts or existing structures that need matching: that's most of what we do.

We're involved from the first conversation through to installation, working directly with clients. Our team leads the project from start to finish; the workshop's craftsmen build it, each a professional in their part of the work. When architects or designers are involved, we work alongside them. The question we keep coming back to: will this still look good and feel right in ten years? In twenty?

Materials aren't a constraint here. Oak, walnut, metal, glass, old buildings with unusual finishes that need to be matched exactly. Clients tend to be surprised that the piece feels handmade and also fits with precision. That combination takes effort. We think it's the point.

Furniture that gets passed down.
